headline: NovoJuris Legal advises IndiaQuotient on Utsav App Series A fundraise
sum: Utsav App has raised ₹36 crore from a Series A fundraise led by Atomic Capital, with participation from existing investors IndiaQuotient and Equanimity Investments. Xander Law Associates advised Utsav on this fundraise.
detail: Utsav App has raised ₹36 crore from a Series A fundraise led by Atomic Capital, with participation from existing investors IndiaQuotient and Equanimity Investments. Xander Law Associates advised Utsav on this fundraise. NovoJuris Legal advised existing investor IndiaQuotient on this fundraise. The transaction team Vishnu Sudarshan (Senior Associate) and Manish Krishnagiri (Associate).
